texts.zh:
噬星者已经被消灭，它的遗骸缩成一团并慢慢蒸发，只剩下它的卵鞘和消化系统及其中的恒星物质。

我们的一些科学家强烈要求我们去检测残余物质，另一些则希望能取回其卵鞘。或许它的消化系统蕴含着非常有用的知识，或者我们可以从其卵鞘中找到什么有趣的发现呢？
texts.en:
The Stellar Devourer has been vanquished. Its remains curled up and evaporated, leaving only its egg sac and its digestive system with the stellar matter it contains.

Some of our scientists have urged us to examine the remains, while others wish for us to retrieve the egg sac. Maybe there is some profound knowledge to be had from understanding its digestive system, or might we gain some insight from the egg sac?

texts.zh:
噬星者已经被消灭，它的遗骸缩成一团并慢慢蒸发，只剩下它的卵鞘和消化系统及其中的恒星物质。

或许它的消化系统蕴含着非常有用的知识，或者我们可以将其卵鞘带回我们的首都进行研究呢？
texts.en:
The Stellar Devourer has been vanquished. Its remains curled up and evaporated, leaving only its egg sac and its digestive tract with the stellar matter it contains.

Maybe there is some profound knowledge to be had from understanding its digestive system, or perhaps the egg sac should be studied back on our capital?

texts.zh: 吞食恒星的怪物被击杀了，它的尸体依然散发着最近被它所吞噬的恒星的能源。对它进行解剖也许能够让我们揭秘它是如何消化宇宙中最热的物体的。
texts.en: The star consumer has been slain, its body still radiating the energy from the star it last fed on. Studying it might reveal the secrets of how it is capable of digesting the warmest objects in the universe.

texts.zh:
对噬星者闪烁的遗体进行研究后，我们的科学家感到既困惑又惊奇。这个以恒星为食的生命体本身就是一个微型聚变炉，通过吞噬恒星物质从而将其转化成自身的能源。

由于尸体中还残留大量之前从[guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]恒星系获取的恒星物质，我们可以萃取这些能源并重新点亮恒星。或者也可以将尸体中的热量收为己用，在短期内满足我们的能源需求，但这会导致该恒星系陷入永久的冰期。
texts.en:
Studies of the Stellar Devourer's shining remains have left our scientists perplexed and amazed. The star-feasting being is itself a miniature fusion furnace, harvesting solar matter to synthesize an energy source of its own.

Since the body still contains significant amounts of solar matter from the star of the [guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName] system, the one it last fed from, it could be possible to extract the energy and reinvigorate the star. Harvesting the corpse's heat for our own ends could satisfy our energy needs in the short term, but would doom the system to an eternal ice age.

由于尸体中还残留大量之前从[guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]恒星系获取的恒星物质，我们可以萃取这些能源并重新点亮恒星。或者也可以将尸体中的热量收为己用，在短期内满足我们的能源需求，但这会导致该恒星系陷入永久的冰期。
texts.en:
Studies of the Stellar Devourer's shining remains leave us perplexed and amazed. The star-feasting being is itself a miniature fusion furnace, harvesting solar matter to synthesize an energy source of its own.

Since the body still contains significant amounts of solar matter from the star of the [guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName] system, the one it last fed from, it could be possible to extract the energy and reinvigorate the star. Harvesting the corpse's heat for our own ends could satisfy our energy needs in the short term, but would doom the system to an eternal ice age.

texts.zh: 彻底研究过这个噬星者后，我们找到了一个方法可以将被吞噬的恒星恢复成初始形态，让这个陷入了寒冬的恒星系重新感受到恒星的温暖。
texts.en: After having studied the stellar devourer we've found a way to maybe return the consumed star mass to its point of origin, restoring the warmth to the system now stuck in an eternal winter.

texts.zh: 项目成功了！将噬星者的遗骸没入[guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]的恒星后，恒星的火焰恢复高涨。恒星系内的各个行星逐渐回暖，并随着生态系统的重建恢复成了过去的样子。其中一颗冰封星球解冻，露出了盖亚星球，富饶的土地完全适于殖民。
texts.en: The project was a success! Submerging the Stellar Devourer's remains in the [guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName] system's star has stoked the flames of the solar furnace. The planets in the system are heating up, reverting to their past forms as their ecologies recover. Among them was a frozen world, now thawing to reveal a Gaia world, ripe and ready for colonization.

texts.zh:
实施这项计划获得了回报，但也付出了不小的代价。将噬星者的遗骸沉入[guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]的恒星之中后，恒星的燃烧似乎变得剧烈了，但也喷发出火焰吞噬了[Root.GetName]和上面的船员。所有人无一生还。

恒星系中行星的温度快速回升，已经接近这些行星原本的温度。
texts.en:
The project has paid off, but at a cost. Submerging the Stellar Devourer's remains into [guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]'s star has caused the solar furnace to shine a bit brighter, but also to spew out solar flares that engulfed the [Root.GetName] and its crew in a roaring inferno. There were no survivors.
The planets in the system are heating up, reaching temperature levels closer to their original form.
